name: Image → text-to-image prompt
description: Turns a reference picture into a prompt you can paste into the image generator. The answer comes back as a sentence, not as comma-separated tag soup: this model will not follow a formatting instruction, so read it as a starting point and tighten it in the prompt box.

parameters.label: Question / instruction
parameters.default: What would be a good prompt to generate this image?

parameters.label: Compute device
parameters.description: vulkan offloads to the Radeon 8060S through llama.cpp's Vulkan backend; cpu is the fallback and about 3-5x slower. Neither one touches the ROCm container.

notes: Moondream2 (2B, 2025-04-14) runs on the host through llama.cpp's multimodal CLI, so the answer costs no VRAM and no engine round-trip. The model is a captioner, not an oracle: it reads what is plainly visible and invents nothing, but it cannot count above a handful or read small text reliably.
